svg.text: Falcon BMS TMS/DMS/CMS Guide · VERSION-SYSTEM · Effective 10 Jan 2026
FIRST QUESTION BEFORE ANY VERSION CHANGE:
CENTRAL RULE: version only bumps when content enters the
guide snapshot (wip/guide/) AND propagates to guide.tex
• WIP files alone (chapter-*.tex, section-*.tex…) → NO version bump
• Compile-only, no content change → update date only (YYYYMMDD)
• Tables integral to chapters — never define MINOR alone
1. Reader must re-learn global structure? → MAJOR (e.g. 1.3.2 → 2.0.0)
2. Significant expansion, but edition stays recognisable? → MINOR (e.g. 1.0.0 → 1.1.0)
3. Local fixes, clarity, small table adjustments? → PATCH (e.g. 1.1.0 → 1.1.1)
MAJOR is rare (editions) · MINOR is less rare · PATCH can happen frequently
New chapter with substantive content enters guide
New relevant section in already-active chapter
New/reworked table changes how chapter is used
Adjust few table cells without changing logic
Work only in WIP files (not yet in snapshot)
Reorganise chapters (merges, splits, major order change)
Add/remove large content blocks, change global scope
New major BMS version requires substantial rewrite
Add important new chapter within same edition
Substantially expand chapters (new sections, key tables)
Reorganise subset of chapters; index stays recognisable
Correct localised errors in text/tables (no restructuring)
Fix typos, grammar, clarity, update references
Adjust table cells, labels, without logic changes
✓ All planned chapters have basic narrative complete
✓ Guide is practically usable by a reader
✓ Partial tables clearly marked (not appearing as errors)
✓ No TODO/FIXME markers in main sections
✓ Chapter index reflects structure to be "frozen" for readers
1. Choose base 0.a.b.c that meets all criteria above
5. Move all guide-v0.*.tex to archive/GUIDE/ (freeze 0.x line)
6. Log in PROJECT-TRACKING: which 0.a.b.c + editorial rationale
7. Create GitHub tag v1.0.0 + Release with changelog
VERSION-SYSTEM · Effective 10 Jan 2026 · Last Updated 25 Feb 2026 · Applies to guide.tex and all wip/guide/ snapshots
